name: Camping Inntal
beschreibung: The **Camping Inntal** campsite is located in the municipality of **Wiesing** in the **Tiroler Unterinntal**, conveniently situated near the **Inntalautobahn** and close to **Achensee**. The surroundings are shaped by the mountain ranges of the **Karwendels** and the **Rofan**. From here, you can reach **hiking trails** and, in winter, the **ski resorts** of **Spieljoch** and **Hochfügen**. The site offers **pitches** for motorhomes and caravans, a **camping meadow** for tents, as well as **rental accommodations**. Facilities include a **sanitary block**, a **restaurant**, and a **heated pool**. Guests enjoy a peaceful, **family-friendly atmosphere** and excellent infrastructure for exploring the region.
